name: When is it advisable to consider removing a bathroom threshold?

mainEntity.name: When is it advisable to consider removing a bathroom threshold?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to consider removing a bathroom threshold in several situations. If you or a family member has mobility issues, uses a wheelchair, or plans to age in place, a curbless shower significantly enhances safety and independence. Additionally, if you are planning a full bathroom remodel and desire a modern, spa-like aesthetic, threshold removal can create a more open and luxurious feel. It’s also a good consideration when seeking to increase the resale value of your home by adding accessible design features.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider removing a bathroom threshold for improved accessibility, aging-in-place design, a modern bathroom aesthetic, or to increase home resale value.
